label: late end-of-input steps (t>=8) of long sequences, weakly content-gated (often first token k)
explanation: Very sparse (0.05% of steps). Fires only at the last original token or the <DEL> step at t = 7-9, almost entirely in L = 8-9 sequences (87% of mass in L = 9). Never fires in the copy phase or before t = 6. The position envelope (phase <= 1 & t >= 7) covers all activations but precision is 0.7%, so which sequences fire depends on content that I could not capture. The strongest content cue is first token k (12.5x lift, 47% of mass); g as the input or previous token, and h/j/i earlier in the sequence, also raise the rate. Top activations are k...h/j...g sequences firing on the 9th token and <DEL>. Best predicate (first_tok k at t >= 8) only reaches dev F1 0.22; adding h/j conditions gives 0.25. Magnitude was not characterised beyond L = 9 > L = 8.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=k (+6.71), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=g (+4.32), orig2=h (+4.18), orig0=t (+4.17), prev_tok=g (+3.76), orig0=v (+3.46). Lower it: phase=2 (-7.91), next_out=- (-4.75), orig7=- (-4.15), orig8=- (-3.48).
